name: Loadout
summary: A versioned composition of capabilities for a role.

behavior.target: Resolve compatibility, exact revisions, authority and budget before acting.
behavior.assay: Compare a source-bound card capsule against matched factual instructions on held-out tasks. Freeze carrier, tools, budget and evaluator; record constraint violations, useful outcomes and operator corrections. See /cards/behavior-assay.json.

runtime.note: Source engineering maturity is a historical author assertion, not fresh runtime evidence.

art.prompt: Original HFO editorial science-fantasy. Obsidian, restrained crimson light, ivory highlights, etched technical geometry, tactile mineral and archival-paper textures. Vertical 4:5, one clear central silhouette, quiet crop margins. No text, numerals, logos, badges, evidence stamps, franchise characters or recognizable franchise art. Conceptual illustration only. Subject: Loadout. Show an organized archive object with a visible relationship to another distinct object. Express the intended role without depicting deployment, victory or authority.
art.alt: Planned conceptual illustration for Loadout; no artwork generated.

behavior_contract.intent: Candidate behavior: assemble the smallest compatible capability set that can produce the requested result.
behavior_contract.when_to_use: When equipping a worker or checking whether an existing composition fits a new task.
inputs: WorkItem inputs, required outputs and effect ceiling
Versioned equipment/interface references, carrier requirements and budget
procedure: Map each task requirement to a needed capability.
Select attachments with explicit revisions and identify their dependencies.
Check interface compatibility and distinguish capability availability from permission to use it.
Produce a composition proposal and bounded verification plan; name unresolved bindings.
outputs: Versioned loadout proposal with compatibility evidence and gaps
failure_modes: Accumulating tools without a task need
Treating a model as the durable actor
Assuming installed equipment grants effect authority

example.situation: A worker must summarize supplied documents and produce a cited table.
example.action: Select only compatible reading and table-output capabilities; explain every attachment's purpose.
example.evidence: Expected: interface references, output contract and a relevant bounded verification plan.

neurosymbolic.neural: Reason about task needs and alternative compositions.
neurosymbolic.symbolic: Bind interfaces, revisions, dependencies, effects and budget.

mutable: Attachment selection within authorized compatible options
frozen: Task output contract and effect ceiling
evolution.fitness: Evaluate task correctness, compatibility failures and resource use against the same requirement set; more equipment earns no automatic credit.
